PT Pintcast is a physical therapy podcast hosted by Jimmy McKay, a Doctor of Physical Therapy and former rock radio broadcaster. The show features conversations with clinic owners, PT leaders, educators, and healthcare innovators shaping the future of physical therapy.

Welcome to PT Pintcast — the podcast-turned-YouTube hangout for physical therapists who want more than textbook advice and dry webinars.

If you're a PT, clinic owner, or healthcare rebel ready to grow your impact and enjoy the ride, you're in the right place. We bring on the smartest minds in rehab, business, tech, and leadership — and ask the real questions with zero fluff.

💡 Actionable strategies
🎙 Candid conversations
🔥 Bold takes (and a few cold beers)

Topics include:

• Physical therapy careers
• PT clinic ownership and business
• Healthcare technology and AI
• Burnout and retention in rehab
• Leadership for physical therapists
